package ir
import("fmt";"encoding/json";"testing";"bytes";"go/constant";"IMPORT_TYPES";"IMPORT_OBJ";"IMPORT_SRC";IMPORT_BASE)
func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T){
 SETUP
 TY.InitTypes(func(s *types.Sym,typ *types.Type)types.Object{n:=UP.NewDeclNameAt(src.XPos{},OTYPE,s);n.SetType(typ);n.SetTypecheck(1);s.Def=n;return n})
 pos:=LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(src.NewFileBase("sample.go","/src/sample.go"),7,3))
 typ:=TY.Types[types.TINT]
 x:=UP.NewNameAt(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("x"),typ);x.Class=PAUTO
 lit:=UP.NewBasicLit(pos,typ,constant.MakeInt64(42))
 mul:=UP.NewBinaryExpr(pos,OMUL,x,lit);mul.SetType(typ);mul.SetTypecheck(1)
 add:=UP.NewBinaryExpr(pos,OADD,mul,UP.NewInt(pos,1));add.SetType(typ);add.SetTypecheck(1)
 ret:=UP.NewReturnStmt(pos,[]Node{add})
 cp:=DeepCopy(src.XPos{},ret).(*ReturnStmt)
 var ops []string;Visit(cp,func(n Node){ops=append(ops,n.Op().String())})
 var out []string
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("%v|%L|%v|%v",ret,add,ops,Nodes{ret,cp}))
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("copy:%t:%t:%t:%t",cp!=ret,cp.Results[0]!=add,cp.Results[0].(*BinaryExpr).X.(*BinaryExpr).X==x,cp.Results[0].(*BinaryExpr).X.(*BinaryExpr).Y==lit))
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("builtin:%t:%t:%v:%d",typ.Obj()==UP.TypeNode(typ),typ.Obj().Sym().Def==typ.Obj(),typ,typ.Size()))
 var dump bytes.Buffer;UP.FDumpList(&dump,"body",Nodes{ret});out=append(out,dump.String())
 sig:=TY.NewSignature(nil,[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("arg"),typ)},[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,nil,typ)})
 fn:=UP.NewFunc(pos,pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("F"),sig);fn.DeclareParams(true)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("func:%s:%s:%s:%s:%t:%t",FuncName(fn),LinkFuncName(fn),fn.Linksym().Name,fn.Linksym().ABI(),fn.Nname.Func==fn,fn.Dcl[0].Curfn==fn))
 for _,p:=range fn.Dcl{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("param:%v:%v:%d:%t",p.Sym(),p.Class,p.FrameOffset(),p.Type()==typ))}
 var pkg Package
 clo:=UP.NewClosureFunc(pos,pos,OCLOSURE,TY.NewSignature(nil,nil,nil),fn,&pkg,1)
 cap:=UP.NewClosureVar(pos,clo,fn.Dcl[0])
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("closure:%v:%t:%t:%t:%t",clo.Sym(),clo.ClosureParent==fn,cap.Outer==fn.Dcl[0],cap.Canonical()==fn.Dcl[0],pkg.Funcs[0]==clo))
 UP.WithFunc(fn,func(){out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("scope:%t:%t",UP.CurFunc==fn,POS==pos))})
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("restored:%t:%t",UP.CurFunc==nil,POS==(src.XPos{})))
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("constants:%v:%v:%v:%t:%t",UP.NewZero(pos,typ),UP.NewOne(pos,typ),UP.NewString(pos,"go"),UP.ConstOverflow(constant.MakeInt64(128),TY.Types[types.TINT8]),UP.ConstOverflow(constant.MakeInt64(127),TY.Types[types.TINT8])))
 for _,name:=range []string{"F","F#YWJjZGVmZ2g=#func1","F#short#func1"}{n:=UP.NewNameAt(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup(name),typ);out=append(out,n.DiagName())}

 // Native reassignment analysis: single definitions, later writes, and
 // function assignment tracking share this function's existing IR context.
 ofn:=UP.NewFunc(pos,pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("Oracle"),TY.NewSignature(nil,nil,nil))
 local:=UP.NewNameAt(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("oracleLocal"),typ);local.Class=PAUTO;local.Curfn=ofn
 initial:=UP.NewInt(pos,9);def:=UP.NewAssignStmt(pos,local,initial);def.Def=true;local.Defn=def
 fv:=UP.NewNameAt(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("oracleFunc"),fn.Type());fv.Class=PAUTO;fv.Curfn=ofn
 fdef:=UP.NewAssignStmt(pos,fv,fn.Nname);fdef.Def=true;fv.Defn=fdef
 ofn.Body=Nodes{def,fdef};var oracle ReassignOracle;oracle.Init(ofn)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("oracle:%t:%t:%d",oracle.StaticValue(local)==initial,oracle.Reassigned(local),len(oracle.FuncAssignments(fv))))
 old:=oracle.FuncAssignments(fv)
 ofn.Body=append(ofn.Body,UP.NewAssignStmt(pos,local,UP.NewInt(pos,10)));fv.SetAddrtaken(true);oracle.Init(ofn)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("oracle-changed:%t:%t:%d:%t",oracle.StaticValue(local)==local,oracle.Reassigned(local),len(oracle.FuncAssignments(fv)),len(old)==1&&old[0]==fdef))
 b,err:=json.Marshal(out);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};fmt.Println("SYNCGO_IR="+string(b))
}
